Due date: Tuesday, April 7th at 8:30am EST. Please submit your assignment as a comment of the link to your website URL, rather than a link to your repository.

For this lab, follow the instructions from the lecture on how to build a website with Quarto and GitHub. For example, you can make a academic/professional website for yourself with some information on your education, work experience, and projects. Alternatively, you could make a website for a hobby, a pet, or a research project.

Additional tips / tutorials can be found [here](https://quarto.org/docs/publishing/github-pages.html). Adding a custom domain is optional (not required).
